response.justification: While Bogdan is a clearly experienced and versatile senior engineer with strong systems-level fundamentals, his career centers on web/full-stack development in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. His professional C++ experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and he shows no exposure to industrial automation protocols, MQTT, IEC 62443, or Secure Development Lifecycle practices — all core requirements for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with strong OOP, testing, and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, caching, fibers) at Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge sharing through workshops, dojos, and conference talks
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience — only ~7 months at National Instruments (2014–2015), far short of the required depth
No industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, DNP 3.0)
No evidence of SDL, IEC 62443, or industrial cybersecurity expertise required by the role

key_factors.factor: Strong general systems and performance engineering skills
